Ubuntu 26.04 image composing this candy, so the suite it writes can be asserted on the
release the org now defaults to. Its plan asserts the apt repo the candy declares;
`check-tailscale-suite-pod` drives it as a disposable target. Together they are the
build-scope gate this repo did not have before opencharly/layer-tailscale#6.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `tailscale`
